mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, aggressive monetary tightening reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST rising for three months fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), decelerating payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals labor market overheating and margin pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In low-unemployment periods (UNRATE < 4.0%), 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth decelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (RSAFS) consistently signals strong household demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates supply chain weakening and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO remains below 98.0 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a federal funds rate decline signals policy response to inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.8% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market supporting wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE remains below 3.8% for two months.
